marks.text: trusted his balance more than any theory
no reaction changed weight by more
the flash: 33 billionths of a gram
to a friend, just after relativity
...or light carries mass, wall to wall
ninety million billion joules = one kilogram
1 g radium, one year of heat:
right at the edge, twelve months on
a way to weigh single atoms
a darkened hut, shielded from X-rays
fuses 600,000,000 tons of hydrogen a second
the stars and your pocket, one equation
under a billionth of a gram
the rest: the strong force — trapped motion
stored energy, shaped like a person
